text:
Priya: Penalty shootout tonight! Whos coming to the conference-room watch? I can snag the projector.
Carlos: Im in. Bringing the foam finger. :point_up: :grin:
Maya: remote here  can someone post the stream link?
Ben: I can stream to the room and cast to TV. plugging in at 7:15pm.
Leah: Quick poll: jersey or casual? Reply with :tshirt: for jersey, :jeans: for casual.
Priya: Also office pool: $5 squares for final score (winner gets vintage team scarf). DM me to buy in.
Carlos: Sold. Im buying two squares and naming one after the mascot.
RemoteNick: link please! my timezone nightmare means ill be on mute but definitely watching.
Maya: Thanks — and can someone save me a chair? my internet is flaky, want to at least see the highlights in the room.
Ben: Stream link: https://streaming.example.com/room-watch (pw: redwood). Posting copy here and DMing remote folks.
Priya: Seating chart suggestion: first come, center seats for loudest cheerers. ; )
Leah: :tshirt: from me. will bring snacks (pretzels + those weird cinnamon chips).
Carlos: I volunteer to handle postgame photo of the scarf handoff.
OpsBot: Conference room "Maple" reserved 19:00-21:30 for "Shootout Watch"  organizer: Priya.
Priya: Also: if we hit overtime, someone please bring earplugs for the bagpiper. (You know who you are.) :joy:
Ben: FYI Ill set up an aux cable and a laptop. if anyone needs HDMI dongle, bring it.
Maya: If score+time grid for squares is needed, Priya can you run it? I can figure out auto-calculator in a minute.
Priya: Yep Ill post the grid. Heres the current bracket for the pool:
```
Top: 3 | 1 | 4 | 2
Left: 0  | 7  | 5  | 2
Squares sold: 18/25
```
Maya: Nice. Ben, can you pin the stream to the channel so remote folks can hop?
Ben: Done. pinned.
Carlos: Is the scarf authentic? hope so.
Priya: Signed by the mascot (that counts, right?).
Leah: Friendly reminder: if youre staying late, badge out and bring a jacket. AC gets cold.
RemoteNick: Cheering from my living room! go team.
Maya: Who wants a pregame warmup 10-min penalty-kicks in the lobby? (clearly not professional-grade)
Carlos: Ill be the goalie and miss intentionally for glory. :sunglasses:
Ben: See you all at 7.15. Ill queue the hype playlist.
OpsBot: Announcement: please clean up the conference room after the event. Recycling bins available.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Final note: if you want in on squares, DM me before 6:30pm. No cash after kickoff.
Leah: May the most ridiculous shot win. :soccer:
